this_court: Rejects the claimed Article III right to a jury trial in supervised release revocation proceedings and declines to create a circuit split by being the first court to so hold; the excerpts show no live split.
quote: Bowers asks this Court to create a circuit split by being the first court to hold otherwise. We decline to do so.
cite: United States v. Bowers, 130 F.4th 672 (9th Cir. 2025)
